title: Create crates/apricity-daw with a cucumber runner for features/daw
description:
## Intent
Create the crate the sidecar work lives in, with an empty cucumber runner, so the first scenario can fail for the right reason.

## Scope
- `crates/apricity-daw/` (workspace member in the root `Cargo.toml`): `src/lib.rs` with modules `warp`, `alc`, `asd`, `error`; deps: `apricity-score` (manifest types), `quick-xml`, `flate2`, `thiserror`; dev-deps `cucumber = "0.21"`, `tempfile`.
- `tests/conformance.rs` (`[[test]] harness = false`) running `features/daw/*.feature`, modelled on `crates/apricity-sources/tests/conformance.rs`.
- `error.rs`: one `SidecarError { file, location: Line(u32) | Byte(u64) | Element(String), message }` whose `Display` is `file: line N: …` / `file: byte N: …`.
- README layout table: a row for `crates/apricity-daw`.

## Coordination
First check whether apricitus-6edba8 (set export) already created a DAW crate; if so, extend it instead and say so in a comment. Link: this chore relates-to 6edba8.

## Verify
`safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw` runs (0 scenarios or all pending) and `cargo metadata --no-deps | grep apricity-daw`.

Commit: `chore(<this id>): apricity-daw crate skeleton and conformance runner`.

---
**Toolchain:** every Bash call starts with `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2`; run builds and tests under the watchdog: `safe-run.sh -- <command>` (6 GB / 20 min cap; do not edit it). At most two Rust-building agents at once.
**Protocol:** specs first (write the scenario, watch it fail, then code); keep a running log with `kbs comment` (decisions, problems, attempts, outcomes); paste the tail of **Verify** before asking for review; never commit, push or close (the reviewer does, after re-running Verify). Never write the DAW's brand name anywhere.
